verdict.rationale: Runloop's core product is isolated sandbox environments (Devboxes) for agents to run and test code. Egress network policies, credential-hiding Agent Gateways, and snapshot rollback help keep testing away from production systems. This is genuine sandbox isolation, not a dry-run mode. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of production-data separation guarantees (e.g., seeded test data or prod/test environment distinction), independent or hands-on corroboration of isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Runloop provides secure sandboxed execution environments called Devboxes.
